value: Rests on the EAR deemed-export doctrine at 15 CFR 734.13 (release of controlled technology/source code to a foreign national in the US counts as an export to their most-recent country of citizenship/permanent residency even if they never leave US soil) — described as the first time the framework is applied to an AI MODEL (vs semiconductors, encryption software, biotech). The rule itself is a genuine, decades-old EAR provision confirmed by Cornell LII, eCFR and BIS.
